{{Top|fa}} {{Youmay|the member of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]]|[[Darth Tigran]], a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]]|linebreak=1}} {{Character |type=Rebel |image=[[File:TigranJamiro-TESB.png]] |name=Tigran Jamiro |homeworld= |birth= |death= |species=[[Human]]{{ForceCollection|Tigran Jamiro|star=1}} |gender=[[Gender|Male]] |pronouns=He/him |height= |mass= |hair=[[Color|Brown]]{{Film|V}} |feathers= |eyes=Blue |skin=Fair |cyber= |families= |parents= |partners= |siblings= |children= |affiliation=*[[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] **[[Alliance Military]] |masters= |apprentices= }} {{Quote|Your tauntaun'll freeze before you reach the first marker!''"
"''Then I'll see you in hell!|Tigran Jamiro and Han Solo|audio=Jamiro-Hell.flac|}} [[Lieutenant]] '''Tigran Jamiro''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] who served as a senior [[logistics officer]] and [[deck officer]] in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War]]. In [[3 ABY]], he was stationed in [[Echo Base]] on the [[planet]] [[Hoth]] when the [[Jedi]] [[Luke Skywalker]] failed to return to the base after going to investigate what the latter believed to be a [[XJ9-CS14|meteor]]. He informed Skywalker's companion, [[Han Solo]], that the Jedi had not returned, then unsuccessfully attempted to dissuade Solo from leaving the base on a [[tauntaun]] to search for his missing friend. After the [[Galactic Empire]] arrived in the [[Hoth system]], Jamiro informed a group of [[scientist]]s and [[Technician|mechanics]] about their arrival and gave a tearful farewell to the group. He then participated in the [[Battle of Hoth]], in which the Imperials attacked Echo Base and forced the Alliance to evacuate. ==Biography== ===Commander in the cold=== {{Quote|Sir, Commander Skywalker hasn't come in the south entrance. He might have forgotten to check in.''"
"''Not likely. Are the speeders ready?''"
"''Uh, not yet. We're having some trouble adapting them to the cold.|Tigran Jamiro and Han Solo|audio=Jamiro-Solo-SouthEntrance.flac|}} [[File:TauntaunCaveCrowd.png|thumb|left|300px|Tigran Jamiro served in Echo Base.]] Tigran Jamiro was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] who served as a senior [[logistics officer]] with the [[Military rank|rank]] of [[lieutenant]] in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War]] against the [[Galactic Empire]].''[[The Empire Strikes Back: So You Want to Be a Jedi?]]'' In [[3 ABY]],''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas: Updated Edition]]'' dates the events of {{Film|V}} to [[3 ABY]]. he was among the [[Alliance Military]] forces stationed in [[Echo Base]], the Alliance's secret headquarters on the [[planet]] [[Hoth]]. The [[Biologist|naturalist]] [[Kell Tolkani]] was amongst the base staff that served under Tigran's [[Commanding officer|command]].{{StoryCite|story=A Naturalist on Hoth|book=From a Certain Point of View: The Empire Strikes Back}} At one point, Jamiro spoke with [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] in one of the [[hangar]]s of the base concerning the fact that the planet's dropping [[temperature]]s had caused the [[engine]]s of all the Alliance's [[speeder]]s to [[Water|ice]] over. She gave the order to Jamiro that all [[snowspeeder]]s would remain grounded until the issue was fixed.''[[Forces of Destiny—Leia]]'' When the [[Jedi]] [[Luke Skywalker]] failed to return to the base after going to investigate what he believed to be a [[XJ9-CS14|meteor]], Jamiro was working as [[deck officer]]. The [[Alliance officer|officer]] and his [[Tigran Jamiro's assistant|assistant]] then rushed into the [[tauntaun]] chamber near the base's north entrance, where Jamiro approached Skywalker's companion, [[Han Solo]]. The [[officer]] reported that Skywalker had not returned through the base's south entrance, but speculated that he may simply have forgotten to check in. Solo dismissed this idea and asked Jamiro about the readiness of the base's speeders, but when the officer reported that the vehicles had not yet been adapted to the cold, Solo prepared to ride out on a [[Murra (tauntaun)|tauntaun]] before anyone could protest. An [[Aide|assistant]] officer then stated he would cover [[Sector Twelve|sector twelve]] and set communication control to screen alpha.[[Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back (paperback novel)|''Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back'' junior novelization]] ===Battle of Hoth=== {{Quote|We'll have to go out on tauntauns.''"
"''Sir, the temperature's dropping too rapidly.''"
"''That's right, and my friend's out in it.|Han Solo and an aghast Tigran Jamiro|audio=Solo-Jamiro-Tauntauns.flac|}} [[File:SoloJamiro.png|thumb|right|300px|Jamiro tried to stop Solo leaving Echo Base on a tauntaun.]] Upon seeing Solo prepare to ride out, Tolkani warned Tigran that Solo would need to monitor his tauntaun's vitals carefully if the pair were to survive, as temperatures were rapidly dropping while [[Local day|night]] fell, meaning the creature would [[Hypothermia|freeze]]. Hoping to maintain some control of the situation, Jamiro called after Solo and loudly repeated an abbreviated version of Tolkani's warning, stating that his tauntaun would never survive outside the base. Solo disregarded the warning and rode out alone. Neither Solo nor Skywalker returned to the base that [[Standard day|night]], but both were rescued the following morning. Shortly after their return, the Empire arrived in the [[Hoth system]] and began [[Battle of Hoth|attacking]] Echo Base. Jamiro informed a group of the base's [[scientist]]s and [[Technician|mechanics]], including Tolkani, of the Empire's arrival, letting them know that their evacuation slots had been assigned. He reassured them that they would likely survive the evacuation but advised them to write any final messages they wanted to send before leaving, which would then be encrypted and sent throughout the entire [[Rebel Alliance Navy|fleet]] to ensure their delivery if anyone managed to escape Hoth. Before finishing, he informed the group that it had been a pleasure to serve with them and hoped that [[the Force]] was with each of them no matter where they ended up. Tolkani chose to remain on Hoth to continue studying the native wildlife and mentioned Jamiro in a message explaining the decision that was intended for the naturalist's [[parent]]s. Jamiro was then among the personnel that took part in the battle, and although the Alliance was defeated by [[Imperial Military|Imperial forces]], the rebels managed to successfully evacuate much of the base. ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|It has been a pleasure to serve with each of you. And wherever we go on this day, may the Force be with us.|Jamiro says goodbye to the mechanics and scientists|}} Jamiro was aghast at Solo's plan to ride out on a tauntaun and considered it pure madness. When informing the scientists and mechanics that the Empire had arrived, Jamiro's voice was resigned and not as strong as Tolkani believed he probably would have liked. When saying farewell to the group, Jamiro's [[eye]]s filmed with tears, but his voice showed no sign of them. He had fair skin, [[Color|brown]] [[hair]], and blue eyes. ==Equipment== {{Quote|All snow-speeders will remain on the ground until we can figure this out, officer Jamiro.''"
"''At your command.|Leia Organa and Tigran Jamiro discuss the iced over speeder engines|}} Jamiro wore a set of [[Alliance military uniform|rebel snow gear]] that included a brown sleeveless [[jacket]] over a white [[Clothing|uniform]], as well as white [[command gauntlet]]s and a white [[insulated watch cap]] with a [[Comlink|com set]], a brown face wrap, and white [[Hat|cap]] warmers. ==Behind the scenes== ===Production, naming, and inconsistencies=== [[File:TauntaunCaveSet.png|thumb|left|250px|Ray Hassett (right) on the set of ''The Empire Strikes Back'']] Tigran Jamiro was portrayed by [[Ray Hassett]] in the [[1980]] [[original trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']]. His scene was filmed between [[March 29]] and [[April 4]], [[1979]].''[[The Making of The Empire Strikes Back]]'' Hassett was only credited as one of several "Other officers" in the film. The character's name was first established in the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in the [[Star Wars video games|mobile card game]] ''[[Star Wars: Force Collection]]'', which initially launched in [[2013]]. Although the launch of ''Force Collection'' predates{{SW|url=news/announcing-star-wars-force-collection|text=Announcing Star Wars: Force Collection|nolive=1}} the ''Star Wars'' canon reset of [[2014]],{{SW|url=news/the-legendary-star-wars-expanded-universe-turns-a-new-page|text=The Legendary Star Wars Expanded Universe Turns a New Page}} [[Lucasfilm Story Group]] member [[Leland Chee]] confirmed that the game was kept updated to fit with canon.{{Twitter|holocronkeeper|status/846807700482666496|[[Leland Chee]]|quote=I'm not gonna go through the trouble of changing them and I don't have any reason to believe currently that anyone would. […] On the off-chance that we DID have a current need to change any of these, we would have for Force Collection.|archivefile=File:Leland_Chee_Force_Collection.png|archivedate=20190727180426}} — [[Leland Chee]] of the [[Lucasfilm Story Group]] has confirmed that [[in-universe]] information from ''[[Star Wars: Force Collection]]'' conforms with ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]]. The name [[Tigran Jamiro/Legends|Tigran Jamiro]] originated in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, where it first appeared on a card in the [[1996]] ''[[Hoth Limited]]'' expansion set of the [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]] by [[Decipher]]{{CCG|set=Hoth Limited|cardname=Tigran Jamiro}} In ''Force Collection'', the image used on Jamiro's card is one of fellow rebel officer [[Bren Derlin]].{{Databank|major-bren-derlin|Major Bren Derlin}} ''[[The Empire Strikes Back: So You Want to Be a Jedi?]]'', a [[2015]] novelization of ''The Empire Strikes Back'' by [[Adam Gidwitz]], alters Jamiro's film scene to have Leia Organa and the [[droid]]s [[C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2]] present. The [[2017]] [[Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back (paperback novel)|junior novelization]] of the film by [[Ryder Windham]] only slightly alters some of Jamiro's dialogue. ===LEGO=== {{Quote|General, there's a fleet of Star Destroyers coming out of hyperspace in sector four.|A line spoken by Tigran Jamiro in ''LEGO Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga'', but by Romas Navander in ''The Empire Strikes Back''|''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga]]''}} [[File:JamiroLEGO-LSS.png|thumb|right|300px|Tigran Jamiro (right) in ''LEGO Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga'']] In the [[2022]] non-canon video game ''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga]]'', Jamiro appears with a ginger beard and moustache and is identified only as "deck officer" in subtitles. He is first seen in the opening cutscene of the game's adaptation of ''The Empire Strikes Back'', engaging in a snowball fight with another rebel outside Echo Base as Solo returns from patrol on a tauntaun. He misses with a snowball before being knocked to the floor by his opponent's throw. Inside the base, Jamiro is then using a [[Wikipedia:Chainsaw|chainsaw]] to carve ice into the shape of a [[stormtrooper]] as Solo dismounts. Jamiro then appears again during the mission "Hoth and Cold," where instead of interacting with Solo in the tauntaun chamber, the pair are stood with [[General]] [[Carlist Rieekan]] in the Echo Base command center when R2-D2 and C-3PO approach the trio and inform them that Skywalker has not returned from patrol. Solo and Jamiro then discuss the snowspeeders as in the film before Solo departs with Rieekan. It is then Jamiro that informs Rieekan, Solo, Organa, and other gathered rebels in the Echo Base hangar that a [[Death Squadron|fleet]] of [[Star Destroyer]]s has arrived in [[Sector Four (Hoth system)|sector four]] above Hoth, showing the [[Imperial Navy|Imperial forces]] with a [[holoprojector]]. Jamiro's line about the Star Destroyers is instead spoken by Lieutenant [[Romas Navander]]{{FantasyFlightGames|url=en/news/2019/3/8/in-the-trenches|text=In the Trenches}} in ''The Empire Strikes Back''. [[File:JamiroTrenches-LSS.png|thumb|left|300px|Jamiro is shown in the trenches outside Echo Base during the Battle of Hoth in ''LEGO Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga''.]] Jamiro can later be seen wielding a [[blaster rifle]] among the [[Rebel trooper|rebel soldiers]] in the trenches outside Echo Base during the mission "Assault on Hoth," laughing with the others when Derlin is left with blue marks around his eyes after using a pair of [[binoculars]] to spot the incoming [[All Terrain Armored Transport (Galactic Civil War)|All Terrain Armored Transports]]. The [[All Terrain Armored Transport|walkers]] then open fire on the trench, causing Jamiro and the others to cry out as snow falls to cover them all. They then emerge from the snow and Jamiro is later shown watching as the Imperials destroy Echo Base's [[DSS-02 shield generator|shield generator]]. Jamiro's likeness is also used for the icon of the mission "Aquamarine around the Gills," however, he does not feature in the mission itself. ==Appearances== {{Indexpage}} {{Mediacat|soundcat=Audio files of Tigran Jamiro|imagecat=Images of Tigran Jamiro}} *''[[Forces of Destiny—Leia]]'' *{{Film|V}} {{1st}} *''[[The Empire Strikes Back: So You Want to Be a Jedi?]]'' {{Ab|The Empire Strikes Back: So You Want to Be a Jedi?
